title: Unit input
summary: A number and a unit select in one field for lengths such as 1.5rem or 24px; the value is the two joined, and a value with a unit outside the list keeps its unit.

props.name: value
props.description: The number and unit joined, for example 1.5rem or 12px (empty until there is a number); what the form submits. A value that is not a number with a unit (auto, calc(...)) leaves the number field empty and is kept until the user edits. A form reset sets it back to its initial value without raising the commit event, as a native control does: pk-form raises pk-reset after it, so a host that mirrors the value reads it again there. A browser state restore also sets it silently.

props.name: units
props.description: The units the select offers, comma or space separated; the first is used until a value or the user picks another. A value whose unit is not listed adds that unit to the select.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown in the number field while it is empty.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label) of the number field; the unit select is named "<label> unit". pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Shows label as visible text above the field (linked to it), for use without a pk-field.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Shows the value but does not let it change (the unit select is disabled too).

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the number is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest number (the number, whatever the unit).

props.name: step
props.description: The number's step: any (the default) allows decimals, or a size such as 0.25 that the arrow keys move by.

events.name: input
events.description: The number was edited (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read the value from the element.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the number or picked another unit (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-value-change
events.description: The user committed a new value (same moment as change; carries the value).

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label shown by showLabel.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered field that holds the number and the unit.

parts.name: chevron
parts.description: The arrow drawn on the unit select.

methods.name: focus()
methods.description: Moves focus to the number field.

a11y: A native number input and a native select live in the shadow root: the number is named by label (aria-label) and described by description, the select is named "<label> unit", so both are reachable by Tab and the arrow keys change the number by step. invalid sets aria-invalid and the state is never colour alone (the ring is thicker). Text is 16px and the control 44px tall on a phone.

examples.title: Lengths
examples.html:
<pk-unit-input label="Width" value="1.5rem"></pk-unit-input>
<pk-unit-input label="Gap" show-label units="px rem" value="12px" min="0"></pk-unit-input>
